tasks.title: Store lifecycle unit tests
tasks.description:
Test push, dismiss per id esatto, auto-dismiss expiry, sticky non scade, next_expiry.

---
**Completion summary:**
COVERED by the existing notification.rs test suite (66 tests) — the store lifecycle is exercised end to end: push_allocates_an_id_and_promotes_into_a_vacant_slot, push_queues_after_all_stable_slots_are_occupied_without_an_expiry, dismiss_visible_archives_it_and_refills_only_its_slot, dismiss_pending_archives_without_changing_visible_slots, dismiss_unknown_or_persistent_notification_is_a_noop, expire_due_archives_due_visible_entries_and_promotes_pending, sticky_notifications_do_not_expire, auto_lifetime_expires_sticky_does_not, next_expiry_uses_only_the_earliest_visible_auto_deadline, first_auto_dismissible_visible_id_skips_sticky_and_persistent_cards. Plus the runtime layer: runtime_applies_the_configured_auto_dismiss_to_a_default_draft, runtime_leaves_a_sticky_draft_alone, set_auto_dismiss_affects_only_notifications_raised_afterwards.
VERIFICATION: cargo test -p heca --bin heca notification:: → 66/66; both lint gates exit 0.

tasks.title: Toast action dispatch test
tasks.description:
Verificare che NotificationAction event dispatchi WmAction tramite registry/policy path, non handler diretto.

---
**Completion summary:**
DONE — added a_visible_actions_intent_is_resolvable_for_the_relay_to_re_dispatch (heca/src/notification.rs): a visible card's action resolves by its intent name via NotificationRuntime::action_and_dismiss_after_for_visible → returns the real Intent (name + args) + the dismiss_after flag, so the relay can re-dispatch it through the router; an unknown key resolves to None, not a panic.
The registry/policy path (not a direct handler) is proven by: WmAction::NotificationActionRelay is classified in action_policy() (exhaustive match, action_policy_covers_all_variants test) as ActionPolicy::Global, so it MUST go through route_action; handle_notification_action_relay then re-fires via emit.fire(InteractionIntent::View(intent)) — another full router pass — never registry.execute directly.
VERIFICATION: notification:: 66/66; both lint gates exit 0.
FILES: heca/src/notification.rs.

tasks.title: Reload config success/failure smoke tests
tasks.description:
Test che reload config producer emetta notifiche corrette senza GPU/window; estrarre reload logic in funzione testabile se necessario.

---
**Completion summary:**
DONE — extracted notify_reload_outcome(Result<(), ConfigError>) from about_to_wait (heca/src/main.rs) and added mod reload_notification_tests:
- a_successful_reload_raises_an_auto_dismissing_confirmation: Ok(()) → "Configuration reloaded", severity Success, dedup_key "config-reload", no actions, lifecycle.expires() true.
- a_failed_reload_raises_a_sticky_danger_with_retry: Err(ConfigError::Invalid{..}) → "Config reload failed", severity Error, body carries the parse message, dedup_key "config-reload", NOT expiring (sticky), one action "reload_config" with dismiss_after true.
The config-parse side is covered by heca-config (config_default_toml_parses = good file → Ok; ConfigError has 4 variants for the failure modes). The deduped success-replaces-failure flow is covered by retry_dismisses_the_failure_toast_then_a_deduped_success_comes_back_fresh (notification.rs).
VERIFICATION: cargo test -p heca --bin heca reload_notification_tests → 2/2; both lint gates exit 0; heca clippy-clean (test module moved to end of file per items-after-test-module lint).
FILES: heca/src/main.rs.
